full_blocker_review.reason: Exact rational B-spline source channels now lower to finitely many exact polynomial spans, but genuinely nonconstant polynomial modulation coupled to nonzero trigonometric phase is not reduced by the implemented routes to the constant-coefficient rational trig-polynomial problem. No unconditional general exact zero/multiplicity decision procedure for that residual branch is established by this repair.
full_blocker_review.theorem_context: The residual functions are exponential-polynomial/Pfaffian-style on compact pole-free pieces. Effective restricted-Pfaffian methods are a plausible future constructive research route, but this repair does not implement or qualify the coefficient/sign/oracle machinery needed to turn that literature into programme authority.
full_blocker_review.continuous_skolem_note: Continuous-Skolem literature is contextual evidence for the difficulty of exact bounded exponential-polynomial zero questions; it is not asserted as a reduction, hardness proof, or impossibility theorem for this narrower commensurate trigonometric grammar.
